diagnosis: Cystic tumour of the atrioventricular node
legend: Low-power view showing replacement of the nodal tissue by a cystic tumour of the atrioventricular node (Masson trichrome stain).

diagnosis: Cystic tumour of the atrioventricular node

diagnosis: Cystic Tumor of the Atrioventricular Node
